name: Doukyo Oyako no Ikenai Yokubou ~Himitsu no Yokan ga Shite Tsuiseki Shite Mita Kekka www~
original_name: 同居母娘のいけない欲望 ～秘密の予感がして追跡してみた結果ｗｗｗ～
source:
The parents were going on a long trip. The protagonist was told that during the meantime, he will be living with his mother's acquaintance and be taken care by her.

While the protagonist was dissatisfied with the decision made arbitrarily, once he was invited by the beautiful mother and daughter pair, his feelings were completely blown off and changed into delight.

While spending his days full of excitement, he felt something like a secret desire among the two and decided to pursue them.

As a result, what kind of secret will you see and furthermore, how will the relationship with the mother and daughter change...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=977784]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
父母要去长途旅行。主角被告知，在此期间，他将和母亲的熟人住在一起，并受到她的照顾。

正当主角不满自己武断的决定时，当他受到这对美丽母女的邀请后，他的心情彻底崩溃，转而欣喜。

正当他度过了兴奋的日子时，他感觉到两人之间有一种隐秘的渴望，并决定去追求他们。

结果，你会看到怎样的秘密，而母女俩的关系又会发生怎样的变化……

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=977784]Getchu[/url]]
